title: A query column is populated before the query runs, so a filter in the query does not change its values

source.quote: The syntax after COLUMN defines a query column, which has a data lineage and it is populated in an empty filter context before the query is executed.
source.supports: the values are fixed before the query filters exist

derivation: The column is computed with only the context transition of its row: Bike rows 1, 5, 7 = 400; Helmet rows 2, 3 = 60; Lock rows 4, 6 = 80; Scooter BLANK. The filter on Date[Year] does not reach Product (Date filters Sales, not Product), so all four rows are returned with the stored values, not the 2023 amounts (100, 60, 50).
